Yes, that framing feels right.

For remembering why, I’d want both: tags for organizing and a short personal note for context. I’d also expect the app to fill in basics like the page title and description automatically, while letting me correct them.

For old links, I mean an actual saved copy of the page as it was when I bookmarked it—not only my title and note. For a PDF, I’d want the PDF itself preserved.

A few other expectations come to mind: I should be able to archive links without deleting them, avoid accidentally creating duplicates when I save the same address again, and eventually bring in my existing browser bookmarks and export them again if needed. As the collection grows, filtering, sorting, and making changes to several matching links at once will also matter.
